metadata.title: How to Find Curative Title Deals Nobody Else Is Chasing
metadata.author: Courtney Fricke
metadata.shortDescription:
A lot of curative title investors are looking for the same thing: The secret list.

The problem is, if someone can hand you a copy-and-paste list of distressed properties, they can probably hand that exact same list to everyone else.

As more investors move into curative title, traditional lead sources like tax delinquency, code enforcement, probate, vacant properties, and foreclosure are only going to become more competitive.

So how do you find curative title opportunities other investors aren't chasing?

You learn how to build your own niche lists.

In this episode of the Messy Money Podcast, Courtney Fricke breaks down what she means when she says she's made money in Real Estate simply by being curious—and shares a real curative title deal where one unusual creditor led her down a rabbit hole that ultimately uncovered an entirely new source of potential deals.

ATTENTION:

The information shared in this episode is for educational and informational purposes only and reflects personal experiences and opinions. It is not intended as legal, tax, financial, or investment advice. Real Estate laws, tax rules, and regulations vary by state and situation. Always consult with a qualified attorney, CPA, or other licensed professional before making any Real Estate or financial decisions.
